artworks.title: Carte photographique de la lune, planche XXI.A (Photographic Chart of the Moon, plate XXI.A)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of the moon, highlighting its rugged terrain. The perspective is from above the moon's surface, revealing craters and textures. There is no clear horizon line, as the entire field of view is filled with the moon's surface, transitioning from light to shadow. Craters of various sizes and density are scattered across the lunar surface, creating a pattern of light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey, black, and white. The greyscale enhances the lunar features' depth and texture. The photograph includes scientific information in the margins to provide context as a study of the moon's surface.

artworks.title: Carte photographique de la lune, planche XXII.A (Photographic Chart of the Moon, plate XXII.A)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the lunar surface. The image shows the rugged, cratered landscape of the Moon's surface with various craters and ridges. There is no visible horizon. The photograph captures the texture and depth of the craters in sharp detail. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from dark grays to bright whites. The light source is on the right, casting shadows to the left, enhancing the three-dimensionality of the craters.

artworks.title: Carte photographique de la lune, planche XXIII.A (Photographic Chart of the Moon, plate XXIII.A)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of the moon's surface. It showcases its cratered landscape with high contrast and detailed features. The image displays numerous craters and rough terrain, capturing a part of the lunar surface in top-down perspective. Various textures and depths created by impacts on the moon's crust are visible. Sparse text and markings are present on the border, providing information about the image's origin and geographical coordinates on the lunar surface.

artworks.title: Carte photographique de la lune, planche XXIV.A (Photographic Chart of the Moon, plate XXIV.A)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is an image displaying the surface of the Moon. The monochrome photo shows a detailed and textured landscape with craters and uneven terrain. The craters vary in size, with some being large and deeply shadowed. French text overlays the image, indicating it as part of a photographic map of the Moon, providing scientific details like location and observational notes.

artworks.title: A Sheep
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christine Laba
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sheep. It features a profile view of a sheep facing left in a naturalistic style with attention to detail in the wool texture and body contours. The drawing uses shading and line work to suggest volume and form, emphasizing the sheep's body and fleece. Each detail is carefully rendered, with the contours of the fleece sketched. The background is plain, focusing entirely on the sheep.

artworks.title: Studies of Sheep
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Christine Laba
artworks.description: The image shows two sketch drawings of sheep on a textured gray paper. The color palette is primarily shades of gray, suggesting a charcoal or pencil medium. The sheep are positioned as described, with two more faint outlines of sheep in the upper left area.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Tobias and the Angel
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.2 × 27 cm (6 × 10 5/8 in.); trimmed within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a landscape with two figures, lush vegetation, winding trees, a river with swans, distant hills, a cloudy sky, and a harmonious balance of detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: The Siege of Tortona, or The Thirst of the People of Tortona (La Costanza dei tortonesi)
artworks.medium: charcoal, black crayon, and white chalk on dark cream, machine-made wove paper, laid down on board
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 193 × 173 cm (76 × 68 1/8 in.) (approximate dimensions; object framed)
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts several figures, with most of their bodies shown. One person on the far right is standing and slightly bent forward, barefoot, and blindfolded, holding what appears to be a helmet in their right hand and a spade in their left. Another individual reaching towards this helmet is standing, bending forward with an intense expression, their head covered with a hood. To the left, a person with a fist raised, grimacing and also featuring a hood, stands slightly behind the first two. Below them, there is a kneeling figure, their face obscured by a hood, appearing to drink from cupped hands. In the foreground, another figure lies prone, their face partially turned down towards the ground. The scene is set against a plain background, emphasizing the figures in the foreground without any discernible environmental details. The image is monochrome and appears to be a sketch with visible pencil lines and shading.

artworks.title: Dieppe Cathedral
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of gouache over traces of graphite on wove paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows a painting depicting a market scene with a large cathedral on the left side. The cathedral has detailed gothic architecture and spires. The market is colorful, with people under parasols of various colors. In the distance, other buildings and rooftops are visible against a soft sky. The overall color palette includes warm tones for the cathedral, mixed colors for the market, and soft blues and grays for the sky. The brushwork is delicate but confident, capturing details of the architecture and market activity.

artworks.title: Christ with Doubting Thomas and the Apostles
artworks.medium: graphite with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals. One central figure is mostly unclothed, standing with one foot forward and draped in a cloth. Another figure, kneeling, touches the central figure's side. Other figures in robes observe. The setting includes an arch and doorway in the background. The figures are closely gathered in the space.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child Seated on a Dais with Tobias and the Angel and a Saint Presenting Two Children
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting numerous figures in a dynamic composition. Central to the scene is a winged figure, possibly an angel, surrounded by other figures who appear to be engaged in conversation or action. The figures are depicted with simple, flowing lines, conveying movement and interaction. Some figures above them appear to be rising or descending. The style of the drawing features expressive, quick pen strokes and lacks detailed facial features.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image is a lithograph depicting a young child's face and part of their upper body. The child is facing slightly downwards and to the right, with soft facial features and short, light-colored hair. The child appears to be wearing a dark garment. The lithograph is on off-white paper with handwritten text below the image. The background of the lithograph is dark. Surrounding the lithograph are some sketched marks and notes.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a child, facing slightly to the right. The child has a round face with short hair, a small mouth, and a gaze directed to the right. The child wears simple, dark clothing, and there are no visible accessories. The background is dark and textured, highlighting the child's face. The name "W. LEIBL" is written at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Peasant Girl in a Plaid Jacket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman shown from the chest upward, turned to the left in three-quarter profile. She is wearing a wide-brimmed hat which casts a shadow over her features. Her facial features, captured in dark tones, show a slightly turned head, revealing prominent cheekbones and a closed-mouth expression. Her hair appears to be neatly tucked under the hat. She is dressed in a patterned garment featuring a checkered design and a dark collar. Her earlobes show earrings. The background is a dense, textured pattern that blends with the profile, creating a soft contrast against the woman's silhouette.

artworks.title: Peasant Boy with a Jug
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome depiction of a person's upper body. The person is positioned slightly to the side with their face turned towards the viewer, looking off to the side. Their facial features are prominent, with a strong jawline, a stern expression, and visible light or grayish hair under a dark, furry hat. The individual is wearing heavy, dark clothing, possibly a coat, and has their hands together in front of them. The background is plain. A signature at the bottom right corner of the image reads "W. Leibl."

artworks.title: Landscape with Resting Children ("La Dolce far niente")
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a landscape with a person lying on the grass under a tree, overlooking a body of water in the distance. The trees are intricately detailed, and the scene is depicted in varying shades of black and gray on a natural paper background. More trees line the horizon.

artworks.title: The Large Tree
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image displays a tall tree in the center, with the horizon low in the composition. A cow appears on the right side, against a light backdrop. The tree and vegetation around it are depicted with dark tones and defined brushstrokes. The color scheme consists mainly of black, gray, and pale shades, emphasizing the tree's silhouette and surrounding details.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Peasant Woman, in Profile to the Right
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and upper shoulders of a person in profile facing right. The person has aged, wrinkled skin and is wearing a dark hat covering most of their head, with some hair visible. They also wear a dark garment around their shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with subtle lines suggesting an artistic medium such as etching. In the top right corner, there is a signature and the year "1874."

artworks.title: Old Farmer with a Hat
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an elderly person in profile, facing left. The person is either seated or standing in a relaxed position with their right hand resting on a cane or stick. They have a deeply lined face with distinct wrinkles around their eyes and mouth. Their hair is combed back and partially covered by a tall, wide-brimmed hat. They are wearing a dark-colored coat with a high collar. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Portrait of the Painter Sperl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in profile, facing left. He holds a mug in his right hand, and his left hand is near his mouth. The man has a beard and mustache, with combed back hair. He wears a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt. Light and shadow suggest texture and depth, emphasizing his expression. A pipe extends from his mouth. The background is a plain light color.

artworks.title: Team of Oxen in Harness
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows two oxen hitched to a cart or plow, facing right. The horizon is visible with minimal details, and there are distant trees. The oxen are drawn with loose strokes in a monochromatic color scheme against a pale background.

artworks.title: Farmhouse
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image displays an old house partially hidden by leafless trees. The view is from slightly below the horizon at eye level, with the horizon aligning with the upper part of the house. The artistic style features detailed cross-hatching and linear strokes creating texture in the trees and roof. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black and white to show contrast and depth. Trees are in the foreground, followed by the house as the focal point. In the background, thin trees extend out of view, adding to the light and shadow interplay.

artworks.title: Therese Bauer (Head of a Young Farmgirl Facing Right)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. The facial features are subtly detailed with shadows, and the person has a thoughtful expression. They are wearing a dark headscarf or hat covering most of their hair, along with a dark garment that covers their shoulders. A small earring is visible on one ear. The background is plain and textured, with no distinct objects or patterns. In the bottom right corner, the name "V. Zein" is signed.

artworks.title: The Smoker (Portrait of the Painter Horstig)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Wolfgang Ratjen Foundation in Memory of Wolfgang Ratjen on the 75th Anniversary of His Birth
artworks.description: This image shows a man's upper body, facing slightly to the right in a sketch-style rendering. The man has facial hair and is wearing a hat, a dark jacket over a light shirt, and his hand is partially visible. The background is textured and shaded, highlighting the figure.
